sources.title: Model Spec Midtraining: Improving How Alignment Training Generalizes
sources.snippet: tl;dr We introduce model spec midtraining (MSM): after pre-training but before alignment fine-tuning, we train models on synthetic documents discussing their Model Spec. This shapes how models generalize from subsequent alignment training.
